proposed_next: Ask critic whether a bounded target-write number guard, strict number-aware selected-item comparison, exact raw removal Undo and detached returned removal item are worth implementing in an isolated candidate; preserve existing supported behavior.
alternatives: A targeted conservative guard/comparator/raw Undo: smaller and auditable, refuses actions when remaining unknown settings would change; does not promise full lexical preservation.
B full configuration-lexeme mutation serializer: more capable but requires a scanner and substantially broader correctness/staleness proof, not currently justified.
limits: Injected memory only, unchanged accepted module, two literal settings/four operations. No normal supported-look corruption, actual human loss, browser/UI or full lexical fidelity claim. No product fix adopted.
